aboutPage.title: About Us
aboutPage.metaDescription: Royal Reklam is an outdoor advertising company based in Samsun, Türkiye, working from survey to installation under art director İshak Bal.
aboutPage.lead: We treat a sign not as a panel, but as a brand's representative on the street.
aboutPage.answer: Royal Reklam is an outdoor advertising company producing in its own workshop in İlkadım, Samsun. Under art director İshak Bal it handles design, fabrication and installation entirely in house, and installs across Türkiye.
story: Royal Reklam is an outdoor advertising company producing in its own workshop in İlkadım, Samsun. One idea sits at the centre of the work: a sign is a brand's representative on the street. A badly executed façade makes you look smaller than you are, however good the business behind it.

That is why we do not fragment the process. The team that designs, the team that fabricates and the team that installs all sit under one roof. The person calculating the cutting allowance on a channel letter knows the person who hangs it. Every problem met on site feeds back into the next project's design.

We are based in Samsun, but our work is not limited to it. For brands opening branches we complete fabrication here and send our installation crew to any province in Türkiye — because a brand's branch in Samsun has to look identical to its branch anywhere else.

honesty.title: No price without a survey
honesty.description: A per-square-metre figure quoted over the phone is usually misleading. We do not name a number before seeing the measurements and conditions.

material.title: Materials stated in writing
material.description: Which acrylic thickness, which LED class, which film — all written into the quotation. Materials do not change afterwards.

schedule.title: We keep to the date
schedule.description: Because fabrication happens in our own workshop, the delivery date we give does not depend on a subcontractor's schedule.

aftercare.title: We do not disappear afterwards
aftercare.description: Fabrication and LED faults are corrected free of charge during the warranty. After that, you still reach us on the same number.
